threshold_proximity_rule.statement: a discrete outcome (a reason bit, feasible, a status, characterization_coverage, None-ness) derived from a toleranced continuous quantity x by a threshold test x vs theta may differ between the implementations only where the Python value lies within x's registered tolerance of theta (|x_py - theta| <= max(4 ulp(x_py), 1e-9 |x_py|), combined with the threshold's own relative slack). Such a difference is recorded NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD with the quantity, theta and both values, and the dependent outcomes of that vector are not scored and are listed; any other difference fails
threshold_proximity_rule.quantities: the abep-gaspath steady-sweep gates as registered in PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_DESIGN_PLENUM_FEED_PY-V2 (R_CHARACTERISTIC, R_STAGE_DOMAIN, R_KN_FEED, R_THERMAL, R_DEADHEAD, R_BISECTION) evaluated per state; characterization_coverage vs 0.38 and 3.2 mg/s

dominance_proximity_rule.statement: a Pareto membership difference is NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD only if (a) the Rust keep mask recomputed by the Rust pareto_mask on the Python objective matrix of that block equals the Python keep mask, and (b) every objective value of the block differs from the reference by no more than its ULP_BOUNDED tolerance (the difference is a near-tie decided by tolerated floating noise, not by a different dominance rule). Otherwise the difference fails

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, error codes, schema shape: equal
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp ulp(py) OR <= r_rel * max(1, |py|) with k_ulp 4 and r_rel 1e-9 (the abep-gaspath steady-path tolerance the F7 values inherit); NaN only where the reference is NaN
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: NOT_APPLICABLE (no RNG in the F7 functions)

decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for the registered functions (within the registered domain); new production results for them come from Rust and carry implementation = rust, rust_commit and this contract id. It is NOT physics validation.
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture design synthesis; no observable depends on an excluded legacy path (RM-R20)
